method: Seven individually rendered positions. XYZ selects an actual source camera; pan and focal length reframe that image. No invented continuous physical camera translation.

camera.name: RevisionNative_window
camera.sourceClippingMethod: Explicit near plane on the derived source camera; unchanged across the bounded rig.

denoisingEvidence.filterRowOrder: Cycles bottom-up; normalized EXR rows reversed before filtering, all output rows reversed back to top-down EXR

focus.subject: Central complete chair and attached writing desk
focus.reason: Keep the central complete chair/desk group as teaching subject. Its back and seat span1.423–1.910m, reciprocal-depth midpoint1.631m;1.6m is the rounded default. The tabletop center1.672m is also near this plane.

baseEV.evidence: Formal empty-window center AgX display exposure0/gamma1, original classroom lighting unchanged; default f/8,0.25s,ISO100. Bright camera-visible source sky remains physically backlit, not new geometry or relighting.
